msrp_notes.basis: Base MSRP before Tesla's destination ($1,390) and order ($250) fees; paint, wheels, interior and FSD options are not included. Where Tesla changed the price mid-year the prevailing price for that model year is used.
msrp_notes.2024 Long Range AWD: $45,990 at the January 2024 launch; raised to $47,490 in spring 2024 and held there.
msrp_notes.2024 Performance: Launched 2024-04-23 at $52,990, $53,990 within days, $54,990 from May 2024 (Electrek, InsideEVs).
msrp_notes.2024 Long Range RWD: Added to the US lineup in July 2024 at $42,490 with 363 mi EPA range (Electrek).
msrp_notes.2025 RWD: Tesla dropped the $38,990 LFP base RWD from the US lineup in early October 2024 (InsideEVs, Teslarati), so almost no MY2025 base RWD cars exist; Long Range RWD became the entry trim.
msrp_notes.2026 naming: On 2025-10-07 Tesla renamed Long Range RWD/AWD to Premium RWD/AWD ($42,490 / $47,490) and added the cheaper Model 3 Standard at $36,990 (321 mi). The dashboard maps Premium -> Long Range so year buckets stay comparable; Standard is its own trim.
msrp_notes.sources: electrek.co/2024/07/12 (LR RWD), electrek.co/2024/04/26 + insideevs.com/news/720137 (Performance), insideevs.com/news/704076 + greencarreports.com (Jan 2024 launch prices), edmunds.com 2026 pricing guide + teslamotorsclub 2025-10-07 thread (Standard/Premium).
